verdict.rationale: Lithic's docs show strong spend-control primitives — card-level Authorization Rules keyed on MCC/country/velocity (lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-17, lithic-docs-26) and card/account Spend Limits (lithic-docs-13) plus card creation endpoints (lithic-docs-9, lithic-docs-25) — which together let a developer lock a card to a merchant category and cap spend. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a 'single-use' card type, exact-amount authorization matching, or automatic card closure after one transaction. Missing for 10: explicit single-use/one-time card type documentation, exact-amount (not just limit) enforcement, and merchant-specific (vs. MCC-category) locking evidence.
